mapper.insert: merge into tea_cart using dual on(m_no = #{m_no, jdbcType=INTEGER} and p_no = #{p_no, jdbcType=INTEGER}) when matched then update set ca_qty = ca_qty + #{ca_qty, jdbcType=INTEGER} when not matched then insert(ca_no, ca_image, ca_info, ca_qty, ca_price, ca_del, ca_date, m_no, p_no) values( tea_cart_seq.NEXTVAL, #{ca_image, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ca_info, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ca_qty, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{ca_price, jdbcType=INTEGER}, '기본배송', SYSDATE, #{m_no, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{p_no, jdbcType=INTEGER} )
mapper.select: select c.ca_image, c.ca_info, c.ca_qty, c.ca_price, c.ca_del, p.p_name, p.p_price from tea_cart c join tea_product p on c.p_no = p.p_no where c.m_no = #{m_no}
